metaDescription: Cultivation's command reference: /cultivation soil, field, diet, and reload.
title: Commands
lede: The /cultivation command tree — inspect soil and diet state, and administer both.

rows: Reports the soil you're looking at (up to 10 blocks) — farmland, or a sweet berry bush or nether wart and its ground: fertility % and band, last crop, enriched %, remaining Fertilizer dose (Fertilizer 7/15)
Sets the targeted soil block's fertility — the testing lever for bands and stewardship thresholds
Surveys the 9×9 plot around the soil you're looking at: average fertility and band, counts of exhausted, enriched, and fertilized blocks, and the crops in rotation
Lists your current fatigue entries (Bread −30%) and your last three foods
Clears dietary fatigue for the target (default: yourself)
Reloads config/cultivation.json from disk and pushes the new rules to connected players, refreshing their soil overlays where the new rules change them
